POSTGRES_USER.description: Superuser name. Referenced by the Form API's DATABASE_URL.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password. Auto-generated on deploy. Referenced by the Form API's DATABASE_URL — do not edit unless you also update DATABASE_URL there.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created on first boot. Referenced by the Form API's DATABASE_URL.

PGDATA.description: Data directory. The parent /var/lib/postgresql is mounted as a volume so data survives restarts.
